international.title: General Pants Co enters voluntary administration, putting hundreds of jobs at risk
international.summary: Australian fashion chain becomes latest retailer in trouble after David Jones, Cue and Veronika Maine Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast The youth fashion chain General Pants Co has become the latest major retailer to slide into voluntary administration, putting nearly 500 jobs at risk as Australia’s retail sector continues to struggle with cash-strapped shoppers and online-only competitors. The collapse comes not long after that of upmarket department store David Jones and premium womenswear brands Cue and Veronika Maine, underscoring the mounting toll of tough economic conditions on established retailers.
